{{Top|ca|leg}}
'''Ton-Zek Aimar''' was a famous [[Chef/Legends|culinarian]] in [[The galaxy/Legends|the galaxy]] by the [[Time/Legends|time]] of the [[Third Galactic War|renewed war]] between the [[Galactic Republic/Legends|Galactic Republic]] and the [[Sith Empire (Post–Great Hyperspace War)|reconstituted Sith Empire]]. Aimar was skeptical of the quality of the [[Foodstuff/Legends|meat]] of the [[arkonok]], a herd animal [[Homeworld/Legends|native]] to the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Onderon/Legends|Onderon]]; Aimar described the meat as "just okay" and "sort of gritty."<ref name="Codex">"{{TORcite|exp=ons|type=codex|Arkonok}}</ref>

==Behind the scenes==
Ton-Zek Aimar was mentioned in the Codex entry for arkonoks in [[Star Wars: The Old Republic: Onslaught|''Onslaught'']],<ref name="Codex" /> a Digital Expansion released in [[2019]] for the [[2011]] [[BioWare]] [[Star Wars video games|video game]], ''[[Star Wars: The Old Republic]]''.<ref name="Patch">{{TORweb|url=patchnotes/10222019/game-update-6.0-onslaught|text=Game Update 6.0: Onslaught Patch Notes}}</ref>
